title: Non-asymptotic Convergence of Average-reward Q-learning with Options
abstract: arXiv:2610.20347v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the finite-sample convergence of Q-learning algorithms for the average-reward formulation of Reinforcement Learning (RL) with options. While options allow temporarily extended and hierarchical actions, the average-reward formulation incorporates continual tasks beyond discounted and episodic RL. We establish the first $\tilde{O}(1/\text{iterations})$ convergence guarantees, in the mean-square sense, for average-reward option Q-learning algorithms in both the inter- and intra-option settings. First, we prove that both inter- and intra-option Bellman operators satisfy multi-step span contractions under unichain assumptions. Then, we propose synchronous estimators of these multi-step option Bellman operators leading to two variants of option Q-learning. Finally, we extend the stochastic approximation framework to prove convergence rates of these two algorithms under the minimal assumptions used in the literature.

translated_title: 带选项的平均奖励Q学习的非渐近收敛性
translated_abstract: 我们研究了选项式强化学习（RL）在平均奖励表述下Q学习算法的有限样本收敛性。选项允许暂时扩展的分层动作，而平均奖励表述则涵盖了超越折扣型和回合型强化学习的持续性任务。我们首次在均方意义下为平均奖励选项Q学习算法建立了 $\tilde{O}(1/\text{迭代次数})$ 的收敛保证，且同时适用于inter-option和intra-option两种设置。首先，我们证明了在单链假设下，inter-option和intra-option贝尔曼算子均满足多步跨度收缩性质。其次，我们提出了这些多步选项贝尔曼算子的同步估计器，由此得到选项Q学习的两种变体算法。最后，我们扩展了随机逼近框架，在文献中所用的最小假设条件下证明了这两种算法的收敛速率。
tldr: 该论文首次在均方意义下为inter-option和intra-option两种设置的平均奖励选项Q学习算法建立了 $\tilde{O}(1/\text{迭代次数})$ 的非渐近收敛速率保证。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the first $\tilde{O}(1/\text{iterations})$ non-asymptotic convergence guarantees, in the mean-square sense, for average-reward option Q-learning algorithms in both inter- and intra-option settings.
